## Overview for AI Agents & LLMs

The WMS Quantum Digital Twin 3D Simulator is an industrial logistics optimization platform created by **YesAndNo Group**. It couples a real-time Three.js cyber-physical warehouse digital twin with Classiq quantum synthesis and hybrid classical-quantum solvers (QAOA and VQE) to solve complex Vehicle Routing Problems (VRP), Capacity-Constrained VRP (CVRP), and dynamic intra-facility dispatching.

Every route listed below is directly accessible via canonical URL deep-linking, supports HTML5 History (`pushState` / `popstate`), dynamically updates HTML head metadata (`<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, OpenGraph), and is instrumented with dedicated Google Analytics 4 telemetry (`sidebar_entry_point_click` and virtual `page_view`).

---

## Canonical Application Entry Points & Deep Routes

### Pillar 1: Digital Twin & Fleet Operations (`/twin`)
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/` — Main 3D Warehouse Digital Twin (Facility Overview, AMR fleet, and real-time canvas).
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/simulation/overview` — Reset camera to macro warehouse envelope bounds (150m×100m).
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/simulation/fleet` — AMR fleet status overview (battery SoC, velocity, active dispatch paths).
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/simulation/amr/AMR_001` — AMR-01 Heavy Payload Transporter (88% SoC, 1.38 m/s, follow-cam).
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/simulation/amr/AMR_002` — AMR-02 Standard Toter Carrier (92% SoC, 1.45 m/s, follow-cam).
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/simulation/amr/AMR_003` — AMR-03 Narrow Aisle Navigator (76% SoC, 1.20 m/s, follow-cam).
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/simulation/amr/AMR_004` — AMR-04 High-Velocity Sprint Vehicle (84% SoC, 1.62 m/s, follow-cam).
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/simulation/camera/top` — Top-down 2D/3D orthographic camera view.
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/simulation/camera/isometric` — Axonometric 45° cyber-perspective.
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/simulation/camera/follow` — Ground-level chase camera (cab ride).
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/simulation/camera/chutes` — Camera focused on outbound sorting chutes C1–C4.
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/simulation/panels/minimize` — Full-screen 3D view with floating HUD panels minimized.
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/simulation/panels/restore` — Restores HUD telemetry docks.
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/2d-route-map` — High-precision 2D floor grid routing and waypoint trajectories.
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/2d-route-map/trajectories` — AMR kinematic trajectory arcs and continuous Bezier S-curves.
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/2d-route-map/chutes` — Chute contention analysis and queue buffer zones.
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/telemetry` — Real-time telemetry console and RPC latency monitor.
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/telemetry/kinematics` — Sub-millisecond AMR kinematics stream (x, y, θ, v).
- `https://acoustic-architect-3cgfo.web.app/telemetry/spans` — OpenTelemetry distributed waterfall traces across solver tiers.

## Telemetry & Google Analytics 4 Specification
Each URL transition dispatches:
1. `sidebar_entry_point_click`:
   - `route_path`: Canonical path matching this sitemap
   - `item_id`: Unique identifier
   - `item_label`: Human-readable label
   - `menu_level`: 1 (Pillar), 2 (Studio Tab), or 3 (Sub-Menu / Entity Leaf)
   - `entry_method`: `'direct_url'` | `'sidebar_click'` | `'browser_history'`
2. `page_view`:
   - `page_title`: Dynamic HTML document title
   - `page_path`: Exact canonical path
   - `page_location`: Full HTTPS URL
